records.title_en: Check the whole before comparing fractions
records.purpose: Compare fraction magnitude without applying whole-number rules to numerator or denominator in isolation.
records.setup: Show 1/4 and 1/8 of the same whole, then show the same fractions drawn on different-sized wholes.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 同一个整体中，1/4和1/8哪个更大？如果两个图的整体大小不同，还能只看涂色图直接比较吗？
records.teacher_prompt_en: For the same whole, which is greater: 1/4 or 1/8? If the two diagrams use different-sized wholes, can you compare the shaded regions directly?
records.expected_thinking: Fractions must refer to a defined whole; for the same whole, more equal parts make a smaller unit fraction.
records.listen_for: Claiming 1/8>1/4 because 8>4; ignoring whether the wholes are the same.
records.variation: Use 1/2 or 1 as a benchmark to compare 3/4 and 5/8.

records.purpose: Treat improper fractions as numbers greater than or equal to one before converting notation.
records.setup: Draw a number line from 0 to 2 marked in quarters.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 7/4在数轴哪里？7个1/4可以组成几个完整的1，还剩几个1/4？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Where is 7/4 on the number line? How many whole ones can be made from seven one-fourths, and how many one-fourths remain?
records.expected_thinking: Four one-fourths make one whole, leaving three one-fourths, so 7/4=1 3/4.
records.listen_for: Treating a numerator larger than the denominator as an invalid fraction.
records.variation: Place 11/4 and convert in both directions.

records.title_en: Make the fraction units the same first
records.purpose: Explain unlike-denominator addition and subtraction through common fraction units rather than a rule alone.
records.setup: Use 1/3+1/4 with fraction bars or a common number-line partition.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 1/3和1/4为什么不能直接把分子相加？把它们都改写成十二分之一后，发生了什么？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Why can we not add the numerators in 1/3+1/4 immediately? What changes when both fractions are expressed in twelfths?
records.expected_thinking: One-third and one-fourth are different-sized units; equivalent fractions create a common unit so the number of units can be combined.
records.listen_for: Adding numerators and denominators separately; performing common-denominator steps without explaining the unit.

records.title_en: Multiplication does not always make a number larger
records.purpose: Build the scaling meaning of multiplication by a fraction.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 8×3/4表示取8的多少？结果应该比8大还是小？为什么？
records.teacher_prompt_en: What does 8×3/4 mean as a scaling of 8? Should the result be greater or less than 8? Why?
records.expected_thinking: Multiplying by a positive number less than 1 scales the original quantity down; multiplying by a number greater than 1 scales it up.
records.listen_for: Assuming multiplication always makes a number larger.

records.purpose: Establish a measurement/grouping meaning for division by a fraction before using an invert-and-multiply procedure.
records.use_when: Fraction division or as an extension where the curriculum comparison requires it.
records.setup: Use a number line from 0 to 3 partitioned into halves.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 3÷1/2是在问什么？3里面有几个1/2？先用数轴说明，再写算式。
records.teacher_prompt_en: What is 3÷1/2 asking? How many one-halves fit into 3? Show it on a number line before writing the calculation.
records.expected_thinking: Each whole contains two halves, so three wholes contain six halves.
records.listen_for: Using invert-and-multiply without being able to interpret the quotient; assuming division must make a number smaller.
records.variation: Use 2÷2/3 and ask how many groups of 2/3 fit into 2.
